artworks.title: Priest Carrying the Holy Sacrament of the Eucharist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.1 × 2.4 cm (1 5/8 × 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length side view of a figure standing in profile facing to the left. The person has a long cloak or robe that drapes down to their feet, with detailed vertical lines suggesting the texture of the garment. The person's head is covered with a hat or headpiece, and their facial features are subtle but suggest a profile view. The individual carries an object in their right hand, possibly a decorated staff or scepter with a complex, ornate top. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.2 × 6.7 cm (4 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a heavenly ascension scene with figures and angels. In the artwork, a crowned figure is elevated above on a cluster of clouds, surrounded by a host of cherubic angels. Several angels are depicted playing musical instruments or in acts of adoration or flight. Below, earthly figures gather around a central altar-like structure, displaying a range of emotional postures and gestures. The border of the painting includes Latin text. The artwork is created in the style of Jacques Callot.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Sacred Cosmologia (Title With Astrologers)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 × 9.3 cm (5 9/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows complex astronomical or astrological instruments set in an outdoor environment. Several people are gathered around a large armillary sphere, engaged in study or discussion. The people wear robes and hats, and some of them hold strange objects. The armillary sphere sits on a stone pedestal, with several tablets and scrolls around it, featuring different geometric shapes. Surrounding the scene are trees and bushes, with birds flying overhead and rabbits on the grassy ground. There are hills in the distance, with more animals walking among the trees.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricately detailed etching showing a bird's-eye view of a busy scene. The perspective is elevated, giving a panoramic view of the activity below. Buildings line the horizon, suggesting a cityscape, with a central spire reaching into the sky. In the distance, an arched bridge spans a body of water with boats and groups of people. The etching showcases fine, controlled lines for texture and depth, with precise engravings of figures and structures. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray, black, and white. An ornate frame surrounds the scene, adorned with swirling motifs and human figures.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving from two pieces of laid paper pasted together
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.8 × 30.1 cm (9 × 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving viewed from a slightly elevated angle, capturing a detailed scene. In the middle, there is a cityscape with buildings and a tall spire. The sky above has light clouds. An ornate border frames the composition with a central grotesque mask at the bottom. Figures in period costumes interact in the foreground, while farther back, a crowd gathers near a river for a mock naval battle. A bridge filled with spectators spans the water. The artwork features intricate linework and textures, using a primarily brown and sepia color palette typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed illustration of a busy scene with a central event. The view is from above, showing people and carriages in an urban setting near a river with bridges. Buildings, towers, and spires are visible on the horizon. The illustration features intricate linework in shades of sepia, giving it a historical look.

artworks.title: The Catafalque of the Emperor Mathias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate interior scene set in a grand hall. The hall is richly adorned with high vaulted ceilings, intricate decorations on the walls and columns, coffered ceiling patterns, and fabric drapery. A pyramid-like structure in the distance, possibly composed of lit candles or lights, stands out. The hall is set up for an event or ceremony, with multiple figures in elaborate clothing. An inscription at the bottom suggests a connection to a commemorative or ceremonial occasion.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed within plate mark): 24 × 19 cm (9 7/16 × 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of an eagle perched above an ornate frame containing a pastoral scene. The eagle has outspread wings and finely detailed feathers. A decorative crown is above the eagle. Below the eagle, there is an oval frame among floral decorations and ribbons. The ribbons bear the words "IAMES" and "AVLTRE". Within the frame is a landscape scene with lions in a rocky terrain. The overall composition suggests an emblem or coat of arms, with the eagle and crown symbolizing power and authority. The engraving showcases the artist's skill in texture and form.

artworks.title: Saint Paul, Seated
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 9.4 cm (5 3/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long beard and curly hair, seated with one arm outstretched and the other resting on a large book in his lap. He wears a robe that drapes over his body and extends to the ground. His expression is stern. One hand holds a staff and there are books stacked around him. In the background, there are dramatic clouds with a shaft of light shining down.

artworks.title: The Float of Mount Parnassus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 20.5 cm (5 5/8 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a crowded scene with figures in classical attire gathered on jagged rock formations. The horizon is implied at the bottom, with fine lines and shading used throughout. The figures appear to be in a ceremonial gathering on the rugged landscape. The artwork is in a monochromatic palette of gray and ochre tones.

artworks.title: The Float of the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.2 × 20.5 cm (5 9/16 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image showing a large central figure holding a spherical object, surrounded by smaller figures engaging in various mythological activities. A chariot being pulled by two horses is depicted on the left. The drawing is done in a style resembling detailed, narrative compositions from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Saint John on the Isle of Patmos
artworks.artist: Attributed to François Collignon after Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.1 × 10.6 cm (3 9/16 × 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with a scroll in a dramatic landscape. A person is seated on rocky terrain near a large rock formation, holding a scroll. The person's gaze is directed upwards toward a celestial figure in the clouds emitting rays of light. In the background, there is a complex cityscape with buildings and possibly a river or body of water. The foreground and background are detailed, depicting trees, a small structure, and rocky outcrops. The artist used intricate line work to create texture and depth, emphasizing three-dimensionality and storytelling through symbolism and iconography.

artworks.title: Lucifer and Demons Fleeing Saint Michael
artworks.description: The image shows swirling clouds and sinuous lines in the sky, with various figures. Below are dynamic, curved lines outlining figures resembling mythical creatures with wings and horns. Architectural shapes resembling classical columns and a domed building are present in the lower section.

artworks.title: Jereo Before the King of the Huns for the Liberation of Saint Ursula
artworks.description: The image features an etching with a centralized point of view. The composition includes a procession of figures and structures in the distance, framed by trees. The horizon line is set high, directing attention to the middle section where a gathering is depicted. Architectural elements and domed buildings suggest a distant cityscape. The intricate detail of the etching includes fine lines and a hatched style, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and grey. The scene includes groups of people under archways and among trees, contributing to a sense of narrative and movement.

artworks.title: The Striking of the King of the Huns and the Collapse of the Rule of Mart
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a detailed landscape with ruins of buildings and a distant city skyline visible on the horizon line at the center. Swirling clouds fill the sky above the horizon. On the left, there is a sculptural detail or ruin among foliage, while on the right, a group of figures stands by a winding path leading into the scene. The color palette is muted, using primarily black, white, and various shades of gray, creating a monochromatic effect.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Saint Ursula in Heaven and the Roman Conquerors
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring a dance performance. The image shows a spacious courtyard surrounded by columns and arches forming an arcade. In the foreground, a group of dancers in intricate attire are performing a synchronized dance. Above them, the sky is filled with clouds and angelic or celestial figures. The composition has detailed line work, conveying grandeur and celebration. The inscription at the bottom reads "Trionfo Di S. Orsola In Cielo E Ballo Di Romani Vincitori." The drawing conveys a mood of festivity and heavenly glory intertwined with architectural splendor.

artworks.title: Jacques Callot
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a forward-facing position, with his body slightly angled to the right. His expression is calm, with a slight smile. He has distinctive facial features including a prominent nose and a short, pointed beard. His hair is wavy and shoulder-length. He is wearing a high-collared, ruffled shirt beneath a long-sleeved coat with visible buttons and layered sleeves. He has a chain with a medallion around his neck. The portrait is encased within an oval frame decorated with feather-like embellishments and an ornate design. Below the portrait, there is a decorative scroll with scripted text, resting on a shield-like emblem. The background features intricate stippled patterns and motifs.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross Between Saint John and Mary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing features a central crucifix, with a figure hanging upon it, flanked by two robed figures on either side. The figure on the cross is depicted with stylized anatomy and a draped cloth around the waist. The left and right figures are adorned with halos and are shown wearing long, flowing garments. Above the scene, there is a small set of initials, possibly the artist's mark. The drawing is rendered with fine, deliberate lines, capturing the solemnity of the scene in a sparse and focused composition.

artworks.title: The Small Carrying of the Cross
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.6 × 6.4 cm (1 13/16 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a diverse group of figures in an oval frame. The central figure is carrying a large cross and appears to have stumbled. They are surrounded by a crowd with some holding spears or pikes and others holding flags with symbols. The setting includes a rough, rocky landscape, an architectural edge on the right side, and figures on an elevated rocky outcrop to the left. The sky is lightly sketched. The drawing technique uses fine lines to capture details and movement.

artworks.title: Man with a Penknife
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated at a table. He is examining an object closely held in his hands. The man has a long, bushy beard and is wearing a beret-style hat, appearing elderly. His hair is slightly scraggly and peeks out from under his hat. He is dressed in a loose, long-sleeved garment, suggesting a robe. On the table are an open book with thick pages, an hourglass, and a partially lit candle in a holder. The background is filled with cross-hatched drawing and appears dark, giving a sense of an enclosed space.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. In the center, one figure is reclining, supported by two robed figures who appear to be mourning. The background is depicted with simple, fine lines, and the use of shading and line work adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas and Jean Eric Rehn after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.description: The image features a printed title page with an elaborate illustrative border. The view is frontal, showing both the text and illustration clearly. Engravings on either side include a woodland scene on the left and a hunting scene on the right. The artwork is detailed with fine lines typical of engraving. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Floral and ribbon-like ornaments frame the hunting scenes in the border decorations.

artworks.title: Loup pris au piege (Wolf Caught in a Trap)
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas and Jean Eric Rehn after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a wolf with its paw caught in a large metal trap. The wolf appears distressed, with ruffled fur and a tense body. Its expression shows pain and fear, with bared teeth and wide eyes. The detailed line work shows the texture of the fur and muscles. The background is simple, focusing on the wolf's struggle. The composition conveys movement and emotion, engaging the viewer's empathy.

artworks.title: Gazel (Gazelle)
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas and Jean Eric Rehn after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gazelle. The drawing depicts a gazelle standing in profile facing to the left. The gazelle has a slender body and long, curved horns. The texture of the gazelle's fur is intricately detailed. The antelope is positioned on a ground setting with a sketch of foliage at its feet. The background is plain. The use of shading emphasizes the musculature and grace of the animal. The drawing is labeled "Gazel" at the bottom, and has a subtle border around the edges, numbered "III" at the top right corner.
